_comment: Name lookups for Valorant replay build ++Ares-Core+release-13.08. status: confirmed = public source AND kit/effect evidence agree; kit_only = kit clearly matches but no source listed the codename; unconfirmed = keep raw codename in outputs.

Wushu.name: Jett
Wushu.evidence: Manifest characterId add6443a-41bd-e414-f6ad-e58d267f4e95 listed as Jett (oanor.com valorant-api example); kit Smoke/Dash/CycloneBoost/Dagger; skill codenames.json

Vampire.name: Reyna
Vampire.evidence: valorfeed.gg codename table; kit NearsightAoE/Escape/Heal/Frenzy; effects HealingDone + EnemiesNearsighted

BountyHunter.name: Fade
BountyHunter.evidence: valorfeed.gg lists 'Bounty Hunter' for Fade (2023 article); effects EnemiesSeized/Marked/Nearsighted/Spotted

Phoenix.name: Phoenix
Phoenix.evidence: Kit Molotov/FlareCurve/FireballWall/SelfRes matches Phoenix. valorfeed.gg lists a different codename (Apollo), so the codename in this build differs from that source

Sequoia.name: Iso
Sequoia.evidence: Manifest characterId 0e38b510-41a8-5780-5e8f-568b2a4f2d6c resolves to Iso (Duelist) on valorant-info-oumi.onrender.com; kit matches oneesports Iso guide (Undercut fragile/vulnerable bolt, Double Tap orb+shield, Contingency wall, Kill Contract arena duel)

Iris.name: Miks
Iris.evidence: Manifest characterId 7c8a4701-4de6-9355-b254-e09bc2a34b72 resolves to Miks (valorant-info-oumi.onrender.com agent page); kit M-pulse/Waveform/Harmonize/Bassquake matches Thumper/Smoke/Harmonize/SonicWave; user also stated it

Pine.name: Veto
Pine.evidence: User stated Pine is Veto; kit matches esports.gg Veto guide: SeizeTrap=Chokehold (trap, holds enemies), UsableTP=Crosscut (teleport), RadEater=Interceptor, SelfBuffVers=Evolution (self-buff ultimate). Manifest ID 92eeef5d-... not independently resolved

/Game/Maps/Pitt/Pitt.evidence: A search result title pairs 'Pearl' with 'Pitt', but no fetched page confirmed it

abilities._note: Class-name -> in-game name. 'matched' = name or effect evidence from sources; 'likely' = slot-pattern only. Folder letters are NOT keybinds in general (see skill notes); pattern seen here: Ability_4 folder = grenade/C-slot ability for Iso, Veto and Miks.

Ability_Sequoia_4_Wave: Ability_4 = wall ability; Iso grenade slot
Ability_Sequoia_Q_FragileMissilePrototyp: 'fragile' debuff = Vulnerable tag; projectile with trajectory warning

Ability_Pine_Q_SeizeTrap: trap grenade that deploys a tether sphere

Ability_Iris_Thumper: Ability_4 slot = grenade slot; spawns heal projectile/object, check
